changelog:
Version 1.0.3

- Updated documentation to clarify recommended usage of the --file parameter for watchlist operations.
- Added a "安全边界" (security boundary) section, warning to only store watchlist files within the current working directory and providing best practices for file location.
- Provided guidance on setting STOCK_WATCHLIST_ALLOWED_ROOTS for use outside the working directory.
- Clarified recommended usage of watchlist init --force to prevent accidental overwriting of unrelated Markdown files.
- No functional code changes; documentation only.
